findings.originalTitle: Unauthenticated API Endpoint Access
findings.originalRootCause: Public access permitted on metrics API without attaching authentication middleware.

findings.originalTitle: Unrestricted User Role Claim Mutation
findings.originalRootCause: Firestore update rule permitted user payload to update role field directly.

findings.originalTitle: Insecure CORS Configuration
findings.originalRootCause: CORS configuration used origin: * with credentials: true enabled.

findings.originalTitle: Broad Audit Log Authorization Scope
findings.originalRootCause: Audit log query endpoint lacked correlationId and project scope filtering bounds.

findings.originalTitle: Server-Side Gemini API Key Exposure Risk
findings.originalRootCause: Client components attempted direct Gemini API initialization using browser environment variables.

findings.originalTitle: Missing Sensitive Header Stripping on Proxy
findings.originalRootCause: Express proxy middleware forwarded incoming request headers unchanged.

findings.originalTitle: Session Token Insecurity & Replay Risk
findings.originalRootCause: Auth state relied on plain token comparison without time-bound cryptographic nonces.

findings.originalTitle: Missing API Rate Limiting on Heavy Routes
findings.originalRootCause: Heavy calculation endpoint /api/insights lacked request rate limiting controls.

findings.originalTitle: Unbounded Request Payload Memory Risk
findings.originalRootCause: Express body parser installed without explicit size payload limit boundaries.

findings.originalTitle: AI Insights Payload Memory Exhaustion
findings.originalRootCause: Raw telemetry arrays included directly in AI prompt string template without bounds checking.

findings.originalTitle: AI Insights Cache Cross-Tenant Leakage Risk
findings.originalRootCause: Cache key generated without explicit project scope prefix and authentication context binding.

findings.originalTitle: In-Memory Cache Unbounded Growth
findings.originalRootCause: NodeCache initialized without maxKeys boundary limit or automatic TTL eviction.

findings.originalTitle: Circuit Breaker Lacking AI Fallback Isolation
findings.originalRootCause: AI model requests lacked execution timeout promises and sequential fallback handling.

findings.originalTitle: Client Privilege Escalation via LocalStorage Override
findings.originalRootCause: Application read user authorization role directly from unverified client localStorage item.

findings.originalTitle: Golden Dataset SHA-256 Checksum Non-Determinism
findings.originalRootCause: SHA-256 calculation relied on unstable JSON stringification without canonical key sorting.

findings.originalTitle: Unchecked Golden Dataset Record Mutation
findings.originalRootCause: Regression engine loaded dataset file without checking SHA-256 checksum prior to running tests.

findings.originalTitle: Synthetic Confidence Artifacts in Regression Suite
findings.originalRootCause: Test runner lacked deliberate defect injection harness to verify suite failure sensitivity.

findings.originalTitle: Non-Deterministic Reference Date in Dynamic Calculations
findings.originalRootCause: calculateOverdueDays invoked new Date() directly inside calculation loop.

findings.originalTitle: Misclassified Superseded Submittal Revisions
findings.originalRootCause: Document status query failed to exclude records marked isSuperseded: true.

findings.originalTitle: Substring Document Code False Positive Matching
findings.originalRootCause: Status mapping logic used code.includes("APP"), matching NOT_APPROVED as approved.

findings.originalTitle: Quality Score Integer Rounding Metric Distortion
findings.originalRootCause: Approval rate formula applied Math.floor() to intermediate percentage calculation.

findings.originalTitle: Uncorrelated Telemetry Log Tracing
findings.originalRootCause: Logger functions omitted correlation ID context from log entry objects.

findings.originalTitle: Non-Authoritative KPI Statistics Source
findings.originalRootCause: Multiple UI screens implemented independent ad-hoc metric calculation logic.

findings.originalTitle: Hallucinated Metrics in Gemini AI Reporting Prompt
findings.originalRootCause: Prompt text lacked explicit instructions forbidding metric estimation for missing telemetry fields.

findings.originalTitle: Circular Import Dependency in Analytics Modules
findings.originalRootCause: Circular reference cycle between useSubmittalData hook and analytics utility helpers.

findings.originalTitle: Business Logic Fragmentation Across UI Components
findings.originalRootCause: Filtering logic duplicated across individual UI component source files.

findings.originalTitle: Alleged Type Error in External Declaration (False Positive)
findings.originalRootCause: Audit false report; type interface was fully declared and valid in source baseline.

findings.originalTitle: ES Module CJS Transpilation Output Failure
findings.originalRootCause: Build script failed to bundle server.ts into standalone CommonJS CJS artifact.
